summary: ERPNext is an open-source enterprise resource planning platform designed to manage core business operations. It provides structured modules to help organisations handle administrative workflows, financial data, and general resource management.
goodFor: It suits small to medium-sized businesses looking for a self-hosted, customisable suite to consolidate various operational workflows under a single interface.
watchOut: Deploying and maintaining an enterprise resource planning system involves a steep learning curve and considerable configuration overhead before it matches specific business processes.
deployNotes: As a Python application containerised with Docker, it typically requires persistent storage volumes for database and file persistence, alongside a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
